name: Absent-Mindedness
description: You are often lost in thought and easily distracted.

name: Amnesia
description: Partial or Total amnesia. Point value varies.

name: Appearance
description: Your physical appearance.

name: Bad Temper
description: You are prone to anger and easily provoked. Point cost varies based on self-control roll.

name: Berserk
description: In combat situations, you may fly into an uncontrollable rage.

name: Bloodlust
description: You have a compulsive urge to kill or inflict grievous harm in combat. Point cost varies based on self-control roll.

name: Bully
description: You enjoy dominating others, especially those weaker than you. Point cost varies based on self-control roll.

name: Callous
description: You lack empathy for others and are indifferent to their suffering.

name: Clueless
description: You are socially oblivious and consistently misread social cues.

name: Code of Honor (Republic Soldier)
description: You uphold military discipline, loyalty to the chain of command, and protection of Republic citizens and interests.

name: Code of Honor (Jedi Code)
description: You are bound by the strict tenets of the Jedi Order.

name: Code of Honor (Mandalorian)
description: Adherence to the strict Mandalorian codes of honor and combat.

name: Code of Honor (Sith Code)
description: Adherence to the Sith philosophy, embracing passion, power, and conflict. Varies from -10 to -15.

name: Code of Honor (Custom)
description: A personal code of ethics. Point value varies based on severity (-5 to -15).

name: Combat Paralysis
description: When faced with sudden danger, you freeze up.

name: Compulsive Behavior
description: You are driven to perform certain actions. Point value varies based on severity (-5 to -15).

name: Cowardice
description: You are terrified of physical danger.

name: Curiosity
description: You have an uncontrollable urge to investigate mysteries or novelties. Point value varies (-5 to -15).

name: Dark Side Corrupted
description: You have been touched by the Dark Side, which may manifest physically or psychologically. Point value varies based on severity.

name: Delusions
description: You hold one or more false beliefs. Cost varies.

name: Dependency
description: You require something regularly (e.g., a specific drug, environment) or suffer ill effects. Point value varies.

name: Disfigurement
description: You have a prominent scar or deformity that causes negative reactions from others.

name: Enemy
description: You have a recurring opponent or group that actively seeks to harm you. Point value varies based on power and frequency (-5 to -40).

name: Fanaticism
description: You hold an unshakeable, unquestioning devotion to a cause, belief, or group.

name: Fear of (Phobia)
description: An irrational aversion to a specific thing or situation. Point value varies.

name: Flashbacks
description: You experience vivid, disturbing memories of past traumatic events.

name: Greed
description: You have an excessive desire for wealth or possessions. Point cost varies based on self-control roll.

name: Gullibility
description: You are unusually trusting and easily fooled by others.

name: Honesty
description: You are compulsively truthful and find it difficult to lie or deceive.

name: Impulsiveness
description: You act on sudden urges without considering consequences. Point cost varies based on self-control roll.

name: Intolerance
description: You hold strong prejudices against a particular group. Point value varies.

name: Jealousy
description: You feel envy and resentment toward others' possessions, achievements, or relationships.

name: Klutz
description: You are naturally clumsy and prone to dropping things or tripping.

name: Lifebane
description: Your presence is corrupting to life; plants wither, animals are uneasy. This is a clear sign of deep Dark Side immersion.

name: Loner
description: You prefer solitude and find it difficult to work in groups or rely on others. Cost varies on self-control roll.

name: Low Empathy
description: You are severely detached from the feelings of others, making true connection nearly impossible.

name: Manic-Depressive
description: You suffer from extreme mood swings, alternating between periods of high energy and profound despair.

name: Megalomania
description: You are obsessed with power and believe you are destined for greatness, often underestimating threats.

name: Miserliness
description: You are extremely reluctant to spend money, even when necessary.

name: Nightmares
description: You are plagued by disturbing dreams, often leading to poor rest. Requires self-control roll.

name: No Sense of Humor
description: You are incapable of finding humor in situations or understanding jokes.

name: Obsession
description: You are consumed by a single overriding goal or interest. Point value varies.

name: On the Edge
description: You live a life of constant stress and danger, requiring a self-control roll to avoid burnout or rash actions.

name: Overconfidence
description: You believe yourself to be more capable or resilient than you truly are, leading you to take unnecessary risks.

name: Pacifism (Cannot Harm Innocents)
description: You are unwilling to harm non-combatants or those who cannot defend themselves.

name: Pacifism (Self-Defense Only)
description: You will only fight to defend yourself or others from immediate attack.

name: Paranoia
description: You suffer from irrational distrust and suspicion of others.

name: Phantom Voices
description: You hear whispers that aren't there.

name: Post-Combat Shakes
description: After intense combat, you experience physical tremors or emotional distress.

name: Proud
description: You have a high opinion of yourself and are sensitive to insults.

name: Sadism
description: You derive pleasure from the suffering of others. Requires a self-control roll.

name: Secret
description: You harbor a secret that would have negative consequences if revealed. Point value varies.

name: Selfish
description: You prioritize your own needs and desires above those of others. Requires a self-control roll.

name: Sense of Duty
description: You feel a strong obligation to protect or serve a specific group or ideal. Point value varies.

name: Stubbornness
description: You are unusually resistant to changing your mind or admitting you are wrong.

name: Supernatural Features
description: Your alignment with the Dark Side has manifested physically, e.g., unnatural eye color or pale skin.

name: Truthfulness
description: You find it difficult to lie or omit facts, even when it might be beneficial.

name: Uncontrollable Appetite
description: You have a powerful, insatiable craving (e.g., for power, knowledge). Requires a self-control roll.

name: Unnatural Features
description: A minor, noticeable sign of Dark Side corruption. Point cost varies based on severity.

name: Vow
description: You are bound by a solemn promise. Point value varies based on severity.
